body.title: Record narrow installed-daemon live qualification
body.summary: After coordinated push/update/restart, run narrow independent review scenarios through registered normal tools, record exact provenance, timings, findings/permanent references and approved cleanup dispositions; reuse only exact covered-kind prior live evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Label hosted versus fixture results honestly; uncovered DEF/HLD/LLD kinds stay unverified and failures are investigated.
Use CliProvider only and explicit human approval for live artifact gates; retain working code-review smoke evidence and no activation-proof framework.
Externally gated: do not mark complete until the operator has updated/restarted the installed daemon and required human approvals are recorded; local fixtures are insufficient.

tests.name: L1 installed daemon independent review, progress, permanent retrieval and human-approved cleanup
